attributes.name: many_rhythmic_repeats
attributes.text: The same short movement repeats many times at a steady rhythm.
attributes.definition: A movement cycle repeats more than three times in a row with roughly even timing.

attributes.name: few_repeats
attributes.text: The movement is done two or three times.
attributes.definition: A distinct stroke repeats a small number of times, with a short pause or adjustment between repeats.

attributes.name: single_occurrence
attributes.definition: The key stroke is made once and is not repeated before the person returns to rest.

attributes.name: reach_hold_return
attributes.text: A pose is reached, held still for a while, then released.
attributes.definition: There is a clear still phase in the middle of the action between a going phase and a returning phase.

attributes.name: sudden_fast_burst
attributes.definition: The main movement is much faster than the movements before and after it and lasts only a short moment.

attributes.name: slow_smooth
attributes.text: The movement is slow and smooth.
attributes.definition: All joints move gradually without fast phases, with no sudden starts or stops.

attributes.name: ends_in_new_state
attributes.text: The body ends in a different posture or place than it started.
attributes.definition: The last frames differ clearly from the first frames in posture or position; the person does not return to the start.

attributes.name: one_side_then_other
attributes.text: The movement is done on one side, then on the other side.
attributes.definition: A movement made by one arm or on one side of the body is followed by a matching movement on the other side.

attributes.name: sustained_fine_activity
attributes.text: Small hand movements continue through the whole clip.
attributes.definition: The hands keep making small motions for most of the clip while the arms and body stay still, without a clear start-stroke-end.

attributes.name: irregular_jerks
attributes.text: The body moves in uneven jerks or wobbles.
attributes.definition: Movements come at irregular intervals with sudden small jolts or unsteady sway rather than a steady rhythm.

attributes.name: windup_then_release
attributes.text: A limb first draws back, then moves fast the opposite way.
attributes.definition: A preparatory backward or downward movement is followed directly by a fast movement in the opposite direction.
